credits.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
credits.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

credits.title: The Weight
credits.overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

credits.title: Stutter
credits.overview: After the tragic death of his wife, Jon immediately starts an affair with the enigmatic Red. The closer he gets to her, the more is his life dominated by an ominous digital signal - the stutter.

credits.title: Simulation
credits.overview: An advanced alien civilization builds a simulated reality where infinite beings, including humans, are imprisoned.

credits.title: Popsy
credits.overview: Sheridan resorts to extreme measures to erase his gambling debts. But one of those measures may end up biting him.

credits.title: The New Orleans Sazerac
credits.overview: To make the perfect Sazerac combine one part technique, one part interpretation, and a dash of folklore.
